packet.title: Casting and lexical forms (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements casting: lexical and canonical forms of the primitive types, integer subtypes with facets, xs:NMTOKENS, and cast and castable with their errors.

body.p: After . Owns src/cast.c, src/cast_lexical.c, src/cast_internal.h, tests/cast_test.c. Lexical and canonical forms of every primitive type the slice uses, integer subtypes with facets, xs:NMTOKENS; cast and castable (FORG0001, FOCA0002, XPTY0004). Done when the cast slice lines pass as unit cases. Spec: F&O 4.0 "Casting"; XSD 1.1 Part 2. Done 2026-10-16 (): all 17 cast slice lines pass as unit cases in tests/cast_test.c (17 cases, allocation-failure loop included).
